question: Which proven interface mechanisms from AXIAL/Lens/RSVP/passive-feedback improve HUMAN PORT hydration and behavior without importing their surface vocabulary wholesale?

donors.mechanism: unequal state vocabularies + visible support + fixed focus gate + moving position witness + explicit OPEN + distinct RETURN
donors.transfer: per-route cue support; inline fixed focus; moving scale/position witnesses from shared aperture; selected route; explicit OPEN gate; route receipt

donors.mechanism: source magnitude + scale + position + fixed foveated focus
donors.transfer: inline source focus at DOCUMENT/PARAGRAPH/SENTENCE/WORD or JSON scales
WHOLE SOURCE vs CURRENT FOCUS while original remains canonical
existing aperture RSVP/TTS controls remain available inside Port focus instrument

donors.mechanism: BACK != UNDO != RETURN; operations must be semantically distinct
donors.transfer: route SELECT != OPEN; route receipt != RETURN; re-entry restores session state
route preference derives only from completed OPEN choices; payload text is never logged

donors.mechanism: one object moves between mechanisms without becoming separate projects
donors.transfer: same source object is handed to Contact/BURST/Idea Atlas/Residue/Lens

result: Port now hydrates an inline focus aperture from the source.
Route support recomputes against WHOLE or CURRENT FOCUS.
Zero-support routes remain selectable; support is not permission.
Route selection no longer navigates immediately; OPEN is a separate gate.
Session re-entry restores source, focus, scope and selected route.
Route receipts store metadata only: route/scope/focus address/source length/candidate provenance.
Specialized tools remain downstream; no new sovereign project created.
Latest AXIAL 0.7.1 observed-use correction retained: focus gate, moving position witness, semantic value and support remain separate readings.
exclusions: Do not copy AXIAL ring-stack aesthetics wholesale.
Do not treat cue counts as confidence or authority.
Do not store source text in passive preference history or route receipts.
Do not call route receipt a RETURN from the downstream world.
Do not auto-open a route from heuristic support.
next_evidence: Ordinary use only: observe whether focus-routing reduces repasting/re-entry or produces unnecessary friction. Refine after repeated choice/override/backtrack evidence.
